en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad Bin Ubeydullah, from Muhammad Bin Isa, Al Qummy, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Adullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding His<sup>azwj</sup> Words
[20:115] And We had Given a Covenant to Adam before

words regarding Muhammadsaww, and Aliasws, and Fatimaasws, and Al-Hassanasws, and Al-Husaynasws, and the Imamsasws from theiras offspring – like this, by Allahazwj, it was Revealed unto Muhammadsaww’.
en.sarwar: 23. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Ubaydallah from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa al-Qummifm Muhammad ibn sulayman from ‘Abdallah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Aallah.

(The commands consisted of certain words about Ali, Fatima,al-Hassan, al-Husayn and the Imams from their descendants) He forgot Our commandment) [20:115].This is how it was revealed, by Allah, about Muhammad and his family.
